summary: Packaged five historical replay evidence sets: T5 exploratory full (369 findings), three fixed-only preflights, frozen-full (12 findings), closure-fixed (16 generation findings), and the distinct mixed-observer full-run-second report (248 findings). All archives passed xz integrity checks; extracted manifest-listed shard sizes and SHA-256 hashes verified; replay shards had nonempty native frames aligned with actions and native inputs. The frozen-full source snapshot matches all 49 before-capture pins; exact source snapshots are unavailable for the other historical mixed-source runs and remain explicitly unclaimed. The live accepted-full output was excluded. Full inventory is in typed-composition/evidence/history-index.json.
